name: TERRACE-8
author: David Ryan
tagline: stages that last: pulses, gates, ratchets, slides
description: TERRACE-8 is a stage sequencer: two lines of eight stages where each stage has a pitch, a number of pulses it lasts, a gate mode (silent, once, every pulse, held, every other), ratchets, slide, accent and skip. Lines run forward, backward, ping-pong, at random or by a random walk, at their own pulse lengths, and an accumulator lifts a line through the scale each time round. Hold a stage key and the knobs are that stage. Its own synth, MIDI out over USB and Bluetooth.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments). After the Intellijel Metropolis and the Moog 960. Fonts: Barlow (SIL OFL 1.1).
